messages:
Marta: FYI I handed in my resignation today; last day Tue 2026-11-09. There's a client escalation thread (NDA'd) I was covering and Im under a signed non-compete clause. Need guidance on client contact taper, calendar ownership and restricted docs.
Evan: Thanks for the heads up. Key asks: ensure no direct outreach to active clients after last day; set an official client "escort" for any follow-ups. Also we need to stop calendar delegations and reassign owner of recurring reports.
Samira-HR: HR notes: COBRA notice will go out 2026-11-10; benefits termination date is 2026-11-24. Non-compete reminder: please avoid client-side outreach per your agreement; we'll send the separation letter with the exact post-employment restrictions. Exit interview scheduled Mon 2026-11-08 09:30.
Maya-IT: Proposed offboard plan focusing on minimal disruption + compliance:
- 09:00 final day: set Slack profile to "Alumni - in transition" and lock external sharing on NDA docs
- 11:00 final day: revoke calendar delegation, transfer recurring report owners to Evan; set auto-reply redirect for client emails to client-escort@redwood.com
- 13:00 final day: make repos read-only for Marta; keep read access for handoff docs
- 14:30 final day: rotate any code-signing keys or long-lived CI tokens Marta had access to and revoke personal SSH keys to build hosts
- 15:00 final day: deactivate Okta + VPN
Commands I'll run and attach audit snippets to JIRA OFFBOARD-5712:
```
# Calendar delegation revoke
gcalctl set-delegation --user marta --remove-delegate "marta-assistant@redwood.com"
# GitHub change
gh api --method PATCH /repos/redwood/project/branches/protect -f required_status_checks=null
# Okta deactivate
oktactl deactivate-user --user marta
# Revoke code-signing key
aws kms schedule-key-deletion --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456:key/marta-sign-key --pending-window-in-days 7
```
Diego-Sec: Security checklist: before rotating keys, snapshot active sessions and export 60 days of access logs for code-signing and client vaults. If Marta used any third-party vendor accounts for client work, rotate those creds and notify vendors per contract. Also request a post-exit monitoring window for 30 days on high-risk assets.
Marta: I'll hand over the NDA client folder and mark sensitive items in the drive. I can't do client outreach after 11/09 per the agreement but can do an internal handoff call Mon 10:00 to go through the escalation queue.
Evan: I'll be the client escort. Please add me as viewer and I will set expectations with the client. Evan -> Samira: do we need a formal client notice?
Samira-HR: We'll draft a client-facing neutral notice for legal review and coordinate with Sales. HR/legal will share the final text; please don't message the client directly until we approve.
Offboard-bot: Reminder: create JIRA offboard ticket OFFBOARD-5712 and attach the Notion checklist + signed non-compete. Link: https://jira.redwood.com/browse/OFFBOARD-5712
Maya-IT: Noted. I'll hold off on Okta deactivation until after the handoff call on Mon 10:00 per Marta's availability. Will run key rotations 14:30 final day and post outputs.
Diego-Sec: After rotations I'll run the entitlement audit and confirm no lingering access. I'll also enable 30-day monitoring alerts on code-signing pushes.
Samira-HR: Final paycheck and PTO payout scheduled 2026-11-16. COBRA notice queued. Exit interview invite sent. Marta: HR will send the separation letter and non-compete reminder to your personal email.
Marta: Thanks all. I uploaded the client runbook, outstanding ticket list, and a note on vendor creds here: https://drive.redwood.com/handovers/marta-client-handoff.pdf. I'll attend the handoff Mon 10:00 and will not contact the client directly afterwards.
Evan: I confirm I'll be on the handoff call and will take over communications. IT/Sec please post the audit proof before closing OFFBOARD-5712.
Maya-IT: Will do. Will attach command outputs and syslog snippets to the JIRA ticket after rotations.
Diego-Sec: Entitlement audit complete post-rotation  no remaining access. 30-day monitoring enabled and logs exported to OFFBOARD-5712.
Samira-HR: Laptop courier label sent; please drop at the authorized UPS or hand to People Ops. Offboard ticket OFFBOARD-5712 moved to Done after confirming laptop receipt and all artifacts. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
